name: VOID DDIM (literal DDIM, node only)
plain: The only literal DDIM loop in core, written for VOID inpainting models that were trained in alpha space. It subclasses Sampler directly, so it skips KSAMPLER's noise scaling, inverse scaling and inpaint wrapper. It only makes sense with those models.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
ᾱ=1/(1+σ²), ᾱ'=1/(1+σ'²). ε̂=(x−√ᾱ·D)/√(1−ᾱ); x'=√ᾱ'·D+√(1−ᾱ')·ε̂.
Input x stays in alpha space, not VE.

props.flow_const: No branch; hard-wired VP alpha conversion.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: Bypasses KSAMPLER entirely. denoise_mask from extra_args is not read.
